findings.body: The previous P2 remains open. Both views read events.jsonl without the writer guard at src/forge/board.py:203–204. On Windows, an overlapping reader can make this replacement raise PermissionError, aborting a worker, reader, reviewer or test command while it records progress. Add bounded replacement retries, following the existing handling at src/forge/codex.py:532–539.
findings.title: Handle Windows readers holding the progress file open

findings.body: The previous P2 remains open. A structured missing-session result is decoded with error_during_execution before its diagnostic. The worker's prefix check at src/forge/worker.py:441–443 consequently misses it; the reader checks stderr at src/forge/story.py:732, although this decoder returns the diagnostic through stdout. Both paths refuse instead of restarting with the full prompt. Recognize this diagnostic in both callers while preserving other failures. The response shape appears in the [upstream reproduction](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/40609).
findings.title: Preserve missing-session recovery for structured Claude errors
